fields.Name: IT71 - File Storage Provider Seams
fields.Description: Deterministic seams of the file-storage abstraction (packages/MJStorage) — no cloud credentials, no emulators. ST1: FileStorageEngine.Config loads the 7 canonical seeded MJ: File Storage Providers rows with their exact ServerDriverKey/ClientDriverKey values. ST2: every canonical ServerDriverKey resolves on the ClassFactory to a compiled FileStorageBase subclass (the metadata-to-driver dispatch seam). ST3: unknown-account lookups fail explicitly — an explicit account ID is never silently substituted, and GetDriver throws the documented error. ST4: an MJ: Files record FK-ed to a canonical provider round-trips (Status/ProviderKey/ContentType + the view-only Provider name) and hard-deletes clean. ST5: account resolution is honest in both states — with zero accounts ResolveStorageAccount() is null and UploadFile throws its documented refusal; with accounts the provider join is intact. ST6: Config is idempotent and forceRefresh reloads without losing the canonical catalog.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The seeded provider catalog, ClassFactory driver dispatch, account-resolution precision, and the MJ: Files record substrate all hold without cloud credentials.
